subject: Marine works - Northumberland Strait - Abrams Village
text:
Marine works - Northumberland Strait - Abrams Village
Wharf reconstruction underway in Abrams Village, Egmont Bay, beginning 5 Feb. 2024 until 1 Nov. 2027, from 1100UTC to 2300UTC, Monday to Friday and occasionally on weekends. A temporary work trestle will be erected adjacent to the existing wharf structure. This temporary work trestle is not designed for mooring of vessels. Temporary navigation buoys will be positioned outside of the work area.
